subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this issue remain open as the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker until live diagnostics prove the exact root cause, or should maintainers consolidate it under a narrower reply-init or stuck-lane tracker now?
rationale: Current source and related reports show several plausible overlapping fixes, but none proves the full WebChat plus WhatsApp one-exchange-then-silence and duplicate-reply behavior is fixed.

options.title: Keep As Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until a broken-state diagnostics export or stable release proof ties the whole symptom set to a specific fix.

options.title: Consolidate Under Reply-Init Work
options.body: Move this under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102400 only if maintainers confirm the reporter's logs match that conflict family.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: If diagnostics show separate ingress/replay and reply-init failures, split those into the existing narrower trackers and close this issue as superseded afterward.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a broken-state diagnostics export or stable release proof ties the whole symptom set to a specific fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent decision surface is the guarded reply-session initialization boundary and its open self-heal path, where this handle appears in recent review/landing history.
